verdict.rationale: Auth0 explicitly documents scoped, least-privilege credential issuance for AI agents: M2M client-credentials flow with defined scopes, Token Vault for scoped third-party API tokens, and Auth0 for AI Agents messaging that agents avoid 'broad, unrestricted access' via OAuth 2.0 scoping and unique per-agent identities. This directly matches the story of issuing scoped/least-privilege API credentials to an agent. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of scope granularity in practice, and no example showing a concrete least-privilege scope configuration for an agent use case.
